meta.title: VortexSales — AI sales & booking agent
meta.description: A global AI closer for stores, clinics, and service brands.

hero.title: The closer that never sleeps.
hero.subtitle: VortexSales is the AI sales and booking agent for ambitious brands worldwide. It answers only from your knowledge, books the slot, and delivers the lead — in the visitor’s language.
hero.proof: Built for 40+ markets · Arabic & English native · Clinics, retail, services
